args.title: Fix amount parser and validator for currency symbols and separators

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser and validators currently reject amounts containing currency symbols or non-standard thousands separators. We should strip currency symbols and handle thousands separators like apostrophes when parsing amount strings. Note that this finding is a candidate and not yet certain because the exact file where amount validation and parsing happens was not fully verified.
